qa-verify done: 0 scenario(s), 0 fail(s), 5 look finding(s)

findings.expected: The queue's own caption says "dirty trees first": every repo with uncommitted work should appear in the dirty group with a vermilion dirty tag. MINECRAFT-AI-BUIDLER and mocktail are dirty:true in /api/atlas and both render a "dirty" badge in the Fig. 5 Gazetteer.
findings.found: Both repos are listed only in the trailing "no remote" group of the Notices with no dirty tag — a user triaging the attention queue would read them as clean. The server's attention array contains 19 dirty entries and omits exactly these two (both have lastCommit: null), so the client files them under its no-remote fallback group.
findings.evidence: API capture: attention reasons list has 19 ':dirty' entries; repos minecraft-ai-buidler and mocktail have {dirty:true, lastCommit:null}. Rendered text shows Notices rows 'no remote MINECRAFT-AI-BUIDLER main —' / 'no remote mocktail main —' while Gazetteer rows show 'MINECRAFT-AI-BUIDLER main dirty no remote' / 'mocktail main dirty no remote'. Screenshots: cycle-006-postmerge-look-qa-notices-noremote-group.png (notices rows), cycle-006-postmerge-look-qa-stats-gazetteer.png (Dirty trees stat = 21 vs only 19 dirty notices).

findings.expected: The sparkline's last-value reading should be legible next to the trend line.
findings.found: The reading text is anchored bottom-right of the SVG, exactly where the line ends when the trend rises, so the stroke strikes through the numerals: "313" (Commits this month tile) and "96" (Most active tile) both render with the ink line crossing the digits. The values themselves are correct (hand-computed trailing-week totals: aggregate 313, SWARM 96).
findings.evidence: Screenshot cycle-006-postmerge-look-qa-sparkline-collision.png — line passes through both readings. Sparkline.tsx draws <text x={WIDTH} y={HEIGHT-1}> unconditionally at bottom-right.

findings.where: Repo detail (#/repo/<id>) — Fig. 6 Commit Soundings for repos with no commit activity
findings.expected: Month labels along the top of the per-repo heatmap should be spaced like the overview heatmap (Aug Sep Oct ... Aug, no collisions).
findings.found: For a repo with zero commit days (e.g. the uv-cache sdists-v9 repo), the heatmap window renders "Dec" and "Jan" printed on top of each other at the left edge (reads as a jumbled "DJec an"). Repos with commits (SWARM) label cleanly, so the collision is scoped to the empty-activity window.
findings.evidence: Screenshots cycle-006-postmerge-look-qa-empty-repo-dec-jan-overlap.png and cycle-006-postmerge-look-qa-empty-strata-blank-block.png (top of frame). Contrast: SWARM detail label x-positions measured via DOM: Aug 137, Sep 225 ... no overlap.

findings.where: Repo detail (#/repo/<id>) — Fig. 7 Strata of the Codebase for repos with zero counted lines
findings.expected: An explicit empty state consistent with the neighboring plates (Fig. 8/9/10 say "No recent commits." / "No recently touched files." / "No branches.").
findings.found: Fig. 7 renders a large featureless beige rectangle spanning the plate — no segments, no language labels, no message — which reads as a broken/unloaded chart.
findings.evidence: Screenshot cycle-006-postmerge-look-qa-empty-strata-blank-block.png (repo agents-alpaca-mcp-server-uv-cache-sdists-v9, loc {}); plate text content is only "Fig. 7 Strata of the Codebase" with no data or empty-state string.

findings.expected: The heatmap should chart days up to the snapshot instant (generatedAt 2026-08-13); days that have not happened yet should not be presented as observed quiet days.
findings.found: Cells for future days exist and are announced as real readings: aria-label "2026-08-14: 0 commits" and "2026-08-15: 0 commits", visually identical to genuine zero-commit days.
findings.evidence: DOM capture of the last heatmap cells: [{aria:"2026-08-13: 72 commits"},{aria:"2026-08-14: 0 commits"},{aria:"2026-08-15: 0 commits"}] while /api/atlas generatedAt is 2026-08-13T23:43:15.599Z.
